· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0218→-0.0218) + no improvement confirmed, maintaining bearish.

· Swing support ($1.28) + based on Pivot S1 ($1.20).

· Current range diagnosis (accumulation phase) + buy on confirmation of $1.28 support, additional buy on breaking $1.29 resistance.
